svg.title: crossing_worst_rank_ecdf_appendix
svg.desc: Six panels show conditional worst-rank ECDFs for each dataset and encoder. K=20 is teal and K=100 is rust. The horizontal rank scale is logarithmic and panel ranges differ. Curves represent full target supports only, with crossing-query weighting.
